intent.description: Independent read-only audit of remote GitHub Issues or local .scratch ticket graphs (parent spec plus child tickets) against live code, tests, and repo contracts. Runs Pass 0 dependency/metadata precheck and Passes 1-7 evidence-backed checks, persists one Markdown report under reports/tickets-review/, and emits one copyable handoff prompt with a structured confirmation gate for a downstream agent to optimize the tickets. Use when asked to review remote tickets, audit GitHub issues or spec tickets before implementation, or check dependencies, AFK readiness, and code alignment (审查所有远程 tickets、审查 GitHub issues、审阅 spec 和子票、检查 tickets 可执行性并输出本地报告和优化 prompt). Excludes Trellis plan reviews (trellis-plan-review), execution prompt compilation (matt-implement-prompt), spec/ticket authoring (/to-spec, /to-tickets), code-diff/PR reviews (code-review, gh-pr-release), and editing tickets or coding directly.
intent.job_to_be_done: Perform an independent, read-only, code-grounded audit of remote GitHub Issues or local .scratch ticket graphs (parent spec plus child tickets), persist one combined Markdown report under reports/tickets-review/, and emit one linted copyable handoff prompt with a structured confirmation gate for a downstream agent to optimize the tickets.
target_users: Maintainers and engineers auditing AI-generated or team-authored GitHub Specs and child tickets before implementation
Teams enforcing a deterministic pre-execution quality gate between /to-tickets and matt-implement-prompt or /implement-spec
inputs: Remote GitHub Issues scope (all open tickets, parent spec plus native sub-issues, or explicit ticket numbers) via read-only gh CLI
Local .scratch/<feature>/issues/*.md ticket sets and optional spec.md
Repository source code, tests, scripts, and governance docs (AGENTS.md, code_map.md, docs/agents/)
outputs: One combined evidence-backed Markdown report persisted atomically at reports/tickets-review/<scope-slug>.md
One lint-verified copyable handoff prompt in a single text fence guiding a downstream agent to read the report, confirm class-3 choices, and safely optimize the tickets
exclusions: Compiling fresh-session execution prompts after tickets are finalized (matt-implement-prompt)
Code-diff or pull-request review and release workflows (code-review, check, gh-pr-release)
Directly mutating GitHub Issues, editing local tickets, or implementing code during review

permissions.filesystem: read-only across repo except single confined write under reports/tickets-review/
permissions.network: read-only GitHub CLI queries when auditing remote issues; none for local .scratch tickets
permissions.shell: read-only python/gh/git inspection plus bundled stdlib Python helpers

portability.degradation: Supports local .scratch/<feature>/issues/ and offline --snapshot JSON when gh CLI or network access is unavailable.

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
